author: nekohunter
body:
I used to play, and really enjoyed, Parallel Kingdom.  Orna is quite similar to it in a lot of ways but is also quite superior in my opinion.  
  
Just like in PK, Orna has a territorial aspect to the game as you capture areas either by claiming uncontrolled wilds or taking over other players’ lands to collect recurring revenues from them and boost your standings in leaderboards.  Whereas in PK you'd accomplish this by whittling away a flag structure, in Orna you fight an AI controlled version of your opponent.  
  
In PK, combat took place on the map itself with a very simplistic sort of tap the enemy to attack and tap healing items every so often.  Orna has a more fleshed out, turn-based combat system reminiscent of the Final Fantasy games, with a full suite of spells/skills and items that heal or buff.  
  
Both games are MMORPGs overlaid onto a real world map, but Orna is more based around your location in the real world than PK was.  PK had a number of ways a player could jump from their physical location to other places, whether by tapping a neighboring territory's flag, by using a city key to return to a previously visited city, or by using the pet to wander off and find unclaimed territories.  In Orna, the only fast/virtual travel option is the Wayvessel portal.  It is more of a method for facilitating multiplayer interactions, as you can only use it to travel to a party member's town.  
  
What really sets Orna apart is that PK often felt like a huge cash grab.  So many of the actions and features in PK such as dungeons, airships, and some buildings required either the purchase of premium currency or crazy amounts of grinding.  Orna doesn't really have a pay to win component, and none of the game's features are paywalled from players.  From one former PK player to another, I'd recommend giving Orna a try.

author: Usual_Assist_4362
body:
Hey... Just your friendly neighborhood Goli here ^-^*
I finally found my PK people!
If you played PK you remember Goli ^-^)/


Let me just say, completely possible to be a F2P player in PK. 3rd richest in the game (gold wise, some of you lot had swag collections at the end of the game that blew my collections out of the water!)


Anyone else remember me losing my account right before the game ended and Assassino used my account to scam MILLIONS from anyone he could fool on top of the 3 Billion worth of shit I had?


That still is one of my worst memories of gaming! Over 5 years of legit trading and building my name for me to get greedy at the very end, lose my acct and have everyone I love call me a scammer 😭


I loved PK and miss it and all it's people dearly! I still think about that game every week if not everyday...


It's what's led me here all these years later still looking for a game that can fill that void...alas I have still not found that game and I miss that feeling so much that I have bought classes on Udemy for coding and RPG game making.
Bought a gaming laptop for the sole purpose of making this game...
Pixel Art software, Voxel Art software, Blender, Spriter, Unity Classes


Countless hours of writing down everything I can remember about PK and how I'd recreate it in a new, modernized and reimagined way..


Open world exploring while dungeon delving with friends with all their own classes and specializations.


Sandbox EVERYTHING! CREATE THE WORLD AROUND YOU AS YOU EXPLORE ITS VAST DUNGEONS AND MANY SECRETS!


Crafting, Leveling, Looting, trading, end game content that keeps you playing for YEARS to come...and best of all...
ITSSSS ALLLLLL FREEEEEEE!!!!!!


The only cash grab in the entire thing would be cosmetics and possible a subscription based that gives you free cosmetics and just like PK allows you to customize your profile for other players to view. (Just none of the P2W aspects, again, purely cosmetic)


But even the in game currency that you buy can be traded with other players!


NO ads, NO paywall, NO pay to win




I don't care if I'm barely skimming by and the game only makes crumbs in order to stay running. I don't care to be rich I just miss that feeling PK gave me.


Never have I been part of such an amazing gaming community as PK 
(And don't get me wrong toxicity was absolutely horrible once the Devs stop caring about it's players but for a time that game was a masterpiece)




GONE BUT NOT FORGOTTEN, PARALLEL KINGDOM. -Goli ^-^*

author: CrowOtherwise4815
body:
Guys, I just want yall to know how much I absolutely miss yall. I may have been a scammer but PK was my absolute favorite game of all time. You can take my PS5 and all the money I’ve spent on it if it would give me one last day to play PK again.

Many of you might remember me as the guy who scammed kosen, kennywho?, and some very old other players out of gen 1-2 swag. I had restarted a bunch of times and went by Romeo, Mr.GrumpyGills, Goldengod, and clip. As much as I hated it, the intellectual stimulation and creativity I spent becoming the richest scammer in pk is something I will forever miss.

Do you guys remember? I freaked everyone out when I posted a bunch of heart shields as my trophies 😂😂 then a bunch of ivy spears. Then a bunch of Kenny’s flowers and rose swords. It sounds stupid as shit but I valued those things more than a lot of my actual material possessions. I will forever miss watching trade chat and just bull crapping with yall.
